title: kotlin tldr deps module-graph wiring
summary: Kotlin was missing from the resolve_import dispatch in analysis/deps.rs, so although the per-file kotlin import parser worked correctly, no kotlin imports were ever mapped to in-repo files. On /tmp/repos/kotlin-datetime (223 .kt files, package kotlinx.datetime) every file came back with an empty internal_dependencies list, making every file simultaneously a leaf and a root. Fix adds package-aware indexing (reads `package <name>` from each file) plus a kotlin import resolver that handles wildcards (`import com.foo.*`), static-member imports, and a stdlib filter for `kotlin.*`, `kotlinx.coroutines.*`, `kotlinx.serialization.*`, etc.

tests.name: kotlin_deps_has_non_zero_modules
tests.asserts: tldr deps /tmp/repos/kotlin-datetime produces > 0 total internal edges

tests.name: kotlin_deps_resolves_internal_imports
tests.asserts: at least one *.kt -> *.kt edge exists in the resolved graph

tests.name: python_deps_still_works
tests.asserts: non-regression: flask deps still aggregates >= 50 internal edges

fix_components: read_kotlin_package(file_path): scans first 4KB of each kotlin file for `package <qualified.name>` declaration, skips block comments and file-level annotations

index_kotlin_module: now accepts the parsed package and registers the file under <package>.<simple_name> (canonical FQN), <package> (wildcard target), simple name, and the path-derived FQN as a fallback
resolve_kotlin_import: handles wildcards, direct lookup, static-member imports (strip last 1-2 components), and bare simple-name fallback

is_kotlin_stdlib: filters kotlin.*, java.*, javax.*, and known separately-published kotlinx.* artifacts (coroutines, serialization, io, atomicfu, collections.immutable). Intentionally does NOT filter `kotlinx.datetime` or other roots that may BE the project.

scope_guardrails.minimal_complete_in_v042: package-aware indexing covers same-package, cross-package, and wildcard imports. No new abstraction; pattern mirrors Java resolver.
scope_guardrails.deferred_to_v043: Aliased imports (`import foo.Bar as Baz`) only affect symbol-name resolution in `tldr explain`/`tldr references`, not file-level dependency edges. Not in scope here.

smoke.kotlin_related_cli_tests: all kotlin tests still pass (definition, context, specs, imports, todo, expression, etc.)
smoke.preexisting_failures_unaffected: Pre-existing failures in cli_tests/test_structure_json_output, php specs, scala importers, ts taint, etc. are unrelated to deps.rs and unchanged by this fix

dogfood_evidence: /tmp/v042_pre_VAL-KT-DEPS_imports.json — pre-fix imports for Instant.kt (parser works fine)
